fields.description: Video training session on creating product sales transactions and setting up installment plans.

fields.title: Buyer Creating QR Code for Payment
fields.description: Video training session on how a buyer reviews their loan balance, checks installment schedules, and makes a payment using a QR code.

fields.title: Seller Checking Customer Debt and Installments
fields.description: Video training session on how a seller checks outstanding customer balances, reviews installment schedules, and tracks remaining payments.

fields.title: Buyer Accepting Sales Order
fields.description: Video training session on how a buyer receives, reviews, accepts terms, and approves a sales order from a seller.

fields.title: Seller Receiving Payment From Buyer

possible_questions: How do I set up an installment plan for a customer?
Where do I enter payment percentages and due dates?

fields.transcript: The system shows that the payment has been successfully received, and the seller clicks send to confirm and accept the payment record[cite: 7].
fields.title: Verifying and Confirming Payment
possible_questions: How does the seller confirm a customer's payment?
What does the payment receipt show in the seller app?
fields.summary: The seller verifies the transaction receipt details, confirms the received amount, and submits to complete the payment update[cite: 7].

fields.transcript: So the seller can check how much money the customer owes[cite: 8]. They enter business management, go to their business, select their store name[cite: 8]. Then they go to the cash collection section and check the debtor list to see customer Sok Sary who owes 3 million Riels[cite: 8].
fields.title: Accessing Cash Collection & Debtor List
possible_questions: How do I check how much a customer owes?
Where can I find the debtor list in the seller app?
fields.summary: The seller navigates to the business management section, opens the cash collection menu, and checks the debtor list to view customer arrears[cite: 8].

fields.transcript: So if we have joined as a loan member, we can apply for a loan right away[cite: 1].
fields.title: Terms, Bank Selection & Verification
possible_questions: How do I select a bank for the transaction?
What verification steps are required before submitting?
fields.summary: The user configures loan terms, selects the bank account (Chip Mong Bank), and completes photo/video verification[cite: 1].

fields.transcript: Then they go to the debtor list and see their debt name[cite: 6]. They click into it and see they have to pay three times[cite: 6].
fields.title: Viewing Installment Schedule & Details
possible_questions: How do I view my payment schedule?
Where can I check the due dates for my installments?
fields.summary: The buyer selects their profile from the debtor list to view detailed installment milestones, installment amounts, and due dates[cite: 6].

fields.transcript: From the seller's app, the seller checks the chat and sees that the customer has sent a payment notification[cite: 7].
fields.title: Checking Payment Notification
possible_questions: How does the seller check incoming payment notifications?
Where can the seller view customer messages in the app?
fields.summary: The seller opens the chat section and checks the notification from the customer confirming a payment has been made[cite: 7].

fields.transcript: So we enter business management, look through the business list, and then select the store[cite: 1].
fields.title: Store Selection
possible_questions: How do I select my store in the app?
Where is the store selection option located?
fields.summary: The user opens the business management section and selects the active store branch[cite: 1].

fields.transcript: The buyer taps to view the contract details and inspects the ordered items and total price[cite: 9].
fields.title: Reviewing Order Details
possible_questions: How can the buyer check the order items and total price?
Where do I inspect the purchase agreement details?
fields.summary: The buyer opens the purchase order details to review items, quantities, pricing, delivery tracking, and total amount[cite: 9].

fields.transcript: From the buyer's phone, we open the chat section to check messages and see a new order request from the seller[cite: 9].
fields.title: Receiving Order Notification
possible_questions: How does a buyer know when a seller sends an order?
Where can the buyer view incoming order notifications?
fields.summary: The buyer opens the messaging/chat section on their phone and receives a notification for a new purchase order from the seller[cite: 9].

fields.transcript: So we are going to create a purchase order for our customer[cite: 1].
fields.title: Dashboard Overview
possible_questions: How do I access the business management menu?
Where do I start when opening the app?
fields.summary: The user views the home screen dashboard and navigates to the business management section[cite: 1].

fields.transcript: They click into it to check the 3 million Riels debt details, showing installment 2 and installment 3 due dates[cite: 8]. Then they check further to see that installment 1 has already been successfully paid[cite: 8].
fields.title: Reviewing Installment Breakdown & Payment Status
possible_questions: How can I view a specific customer's installment schedule?
Where do I check which installments have been paid?
fields.summary: The seller clicks into the customer profile to review the detailed installment schedule, specific due dates, and payment progress[cite: 8].

fields.transcript: So we enter goods for them, knowing they buy 100 kilograms of salmon[cite: 1].
fields.title: Adding Products and Pricing
possible_questions: How do I add items to a sale?
Where do I enter product quantities and prices?
fields.summary: The user searches and selects products like salmon, inputs quantities and unit prices, and calculates the total pricing[cite: 1].

fields.transcript: Then they open their bank app, scan the QR code[cite: 6]. When the payment is successful, the QR code page will show success, and they can click close[cite: 6].
fields.title: Scanning QR Code and Completing Payment
possible_questions: How do I scan the QR code to complete my payment?
What happens after a successful payment transaction?
fields.summary: The buyer opens their bank application, scans the generated KHQR code, completes the transaction, and verifies successful payment confirmation[cite: 6].

fields.transcript: The seller clicks in to check the payment details and reviews the customer's installment schedule and remaining balance[cite: 7].
fields.title: Reviewing Debtor and Installment Details
possible_questions: How does the seller view a customer's installment breakdown?
Where are customer debts tracked in the seller app?
fields.summary: The seller accesses the debtor list to inspect the specific customer's payment milestones and outstanding balance status[cite: 7].

fields.transcript: So we enter the sales out list and click on the sales out button[cite: 1].
fields.title: Sales Menu & Customer Selection
possible_questions: How do I select a customer for a sale?
Where is the sales out menu?
fields.summary: The user opens the sales out menu and selects the customer named Sok Sary for the transaction[cite: 1].

fields.transcript: So this means we have created the purchase and sale, and we are waiting for approval from the buyer first[cite: 1].
fields.title: Transaction Pending Status
possible_questions: What happens after submitting a sale order?
Where can I see if the transaction is waiting for approval?
fields.summary: The user views the final review screen showing the completed sale order waiting for customer approval[cite: 1].

fields.transcript: So at this point, we can take pictures of our merchandise[cite: 1].
fields.title: Photo Upload
possible_questions: How do I upload transaction photos?
Where can I add pictures of the sale?
fields.summary: The user uploads or captures pictures of the merchandise or transaction record[cite: 1].

fields.transcript: So the buyer can go to create a QR code to pay money for themselves[cite: 6]. Then they go to business management, business list, and select their fish store[cite: 6]. Then they go to the cash collection section[cite: 6].
fields.title: Checking Loan Balance & Arrears
possible_questions: How do I check my remaining loan balance?
Where can I view my debt collection status in the app?
fields.summary: The buyer navigates to the business management section and accesses the loan/debt collection menu to review total outstanding balances and overdue statuses[cite: 6].

fields.transcript: Then they click on the first payment[cite: 6]. Here we see three payments[cite: 6]. They click on pay money and select QR code to create a QR code for payment[cite: 6].

possible_questions: How do I choose a payment method for my installment?
Can I pay using a QR code?
fields.summary: The user selects the specific installment period to pay and opens the payment options menu to choose QR code payment[cite: 6].

Where are the terms and conditions accepted in the app?
fields.summary: The buyer clicks to accept, checks all terms and conditions, and confirms the agreement[cite: 9].
